productConcept.name: Oro Matto
productConcept.description: Sardinian wild honey and beeswax studio — raw wildflower honeys, unrefined beeswax, propolis tinctures, and whole honeycomb sections by commission from the macchia hills above Nuoro
productConcept.rationale: The amber/cream palette (#f4b30c accent, #f0ece0 background, #1a1200 body text) maps directly to beeswax and raw honey coloration. The lapidary 0.06em heading tracking evokes the inscriptional quality of artisan labelling. The springy mechanical motion system suits hand-made goods with physical heft. The asymmetric 65px/89px grid creates editorial tension appropriate for a single-producer story. Not a French artisan food brand — chosen to be specific and regional: a Sardinian apiary, not a generic honey shop.
